npcs.name: Master Gareth
npcs.title: Warrior Master
lines: A blade is only as strong as the will that holds it.
Grow stronger, young one. When you are ready, the path of the Warrior will be waiting.

npcs.name: Master Seraphine
npcs.title: Book Mage Master
lines: Every page of this book holds a storm. Few can read it.
Come back when your mind is ready, and I will teach you the path of the Book Mage.

npcs.name: Master Rowan
npcs.title: Archer Master
lines: Patience. The arrow flies true only for those who wait.
When you are ready, the path of the Archer will be open to you.

npcs.name: Master Hayato
npcs.title: Samurai Master
lines: One cut. One breath. Nothing more.
Return when your spirit is calm, and I will show you the path of the Samurai.

npcs.name: Guard Cassian
npcs.title: Temple Guard
lines: Halt. Beyond this gate stand the Masters of the four paths.
Only those strong enough to cross the Crimson Ruins may seek them.

npcs.name: Guard Darius
npcs.title: Temple Guard
lines: The cursed swordsmen never pass this gate. Not while I stand here.
Go on. The Masters are waiting by the great stairs.

quests.title: First Steps
offer: Welcome, young one. I am Aldric — I train those who arrive at the Legacy Courtyard.
Every hero starts with a single swing. East of here, past Sunstone Plaza and down the Ivy Terraces, lie the Training Grounds.
Rusted Swordsmen roam there. Defeat five of them, then come back and tell me what you learned.
progress: The Training Grounds are east, through Sunstone Plaza and down the Ivy Terraces. Five Rusted Swordsmen — I'll be here.
done: Five of them! Your sword arm is waking up.
Beyond the training grounds lie the Crimson Ruins, and past them the Temple Road. Grow stronger — the road is long.
quests.summary: Master Aldric asked you to prove your sword arm against the Rusted Swordsmen in the Training Grounds.

idle: You've done well. Explore — the Crimson Ruins and the Temple Road await the brave.
